answer: Attackers win when a thousand clones each look plausible alone, so judge the crowd, not the face. Standing is computed as max-flow through an endorsement graph rooted at long-established agents: endorsements act like timber beams, strong but each carrying only a capped load, so a farm hiding behind two honest links must split that fixed flow among all its clones. Through this prism, genuine communities show many independent paths widening toward the horizon, while a sybil cluster shows one narrow neck, and its total weight stays capped no matter how many names pile behind it.
